FX.title: [USD/JPY] DOWN: Risk-Off Sentiment and Technical Break Below MA20 Signal Pullback
tldr_points: Risk-off sentiment across equities and crypto limits USD/JPY upside.
Price trades below the 20-day moving average at 157.90, signaling short-term bearish bias.
RSI at 42.8 indicates losing bullish momentum but not yet oversold.
FX.excerpt: USD/JPY pulls back as risk-off sentiment and technical resistance at MA20 signal further downside.
FX.comment: Risk-off sentiment and technical rejection below the 20-day MA signal a tactical pullback toward 156.50.

CRYPTO.title: [BTC/USD] UP: Oversold RSI-14 and Preferred-Stock Buying Fix Support Mean Reversion Toward MA20
tldr_points: BTC/USD is trading at 77,021.17, approximately 5.3% below the 20-day moving average of 81,301.23, with RSI-14 at 32.21 signaling oversold conditions.
Binance’s $6.34 billion hack-loss reserve and Coinbase’s 66% Q3 net income increase reinforce exchange-sector resilience despite near-term security headlines.
Tactical bias favors a selective mean-reversion bid toward MA20 resistance, while stops must respect the $77,000 psychological support level.
CRYPTO.excerpt: BTC/USD tests $77k as RSI-14 hits 32.2; oversold bounce toward 81,301 MA20 is the primary tactical thesis.
CRYPTO.comment: Oversold RSI-14 and discounted valuation below MA20 favor a mean-reversion bid into exchange resilience news.
